video_title: Head Coach Jordan Ott Training Camp Media Availability | Phoenix Suns | 9-30-26

quotes.speaker: Jordan Ott
quotes.text: Shane last year just we got to get to translate, you know, it's 27th in the league, not good enough. We understand at times we're undersized. That's why we emphasize the possession game. There's a there's probably a little cause and effect to how we play defense. Our pressure extends, our pressure probably puts us in some rotations and we don't have a ton of length and wingspan. We were 25th in wingspan last year. It'll be better this year with man man out there. Rashir is 7'5, Miles is is bigger, but it doesn't matter. Everyone needs to help us rebound.

quotes.news_angle: Jordan Ott says the Phoenix Suns will have better defensive length and rebounding this season.

quotes.speaker: Jordan Ott
quotes.text: I'm not going to go down that path. The ball is going to be in his hands. He's going to playmake. If there's two on the ball, he can't shoot. It's really hard to shoot with two or three guys on you. That's probably not ideal for anyone to shoot it over two or three guys. He's going to continue to make the right play. He's going to continue to average over 25 points a game like he's done his whole life. But if the game calls for him to be a passer, he's going to be a passer. He's a basketball player. He's a high level basketball player that he's shown that he can do it whatever the game calls for.
